import copy
from jobs import unique_jobs

def test_stable_dedup_basic():
    """Test basic stable deduplication by (source, source_id)"""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Python', 'source': 'github', 'source_id': 'py-1'},
        {'title': 'Python', 'source': 'medium', 'source_id': 'py-2'},
        {'title': 'Java', 'source': 'github', 'source_id': 'java-1'},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 3
    assert result[0]['title'] == 'Python'
    assert result[0]['source'] == 'github'
    assert result[0]['source_id'] == 'py-1'
    # Second Python should be from medium
    assert result[1]['title'] == 'Python'
    assert result[1]['source'] == 'medium'

def test_source_id_none():
    """Test rows with None source_id are kept separately"""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Test', 'source': 'github', 'source_id': None},
        {'title': 'Test', 'source': 'medium', 'source_id': ''},
        {'title': 'Different', 'source': 'github', 'source_id': 'git-1'},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    # All three should be kept because source_id is missing/empty
    assert len(result) == 3

def test_no_source():
    """Test rows without source are kept separately"""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Test', 'source': None, 'source_id': 'id-1'},
        {'title': 'Test', 'source': '', 'source_id': 'id-2'},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    # Both should be kept separately
    assert len(result) == 2

def test_dedup_across_same_source():
    """Test deduplication works within same source"""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Title', 'source': 'github', 'source_id': 'id-1'},
        {'title': 'Title', 'source': 'github', 'source_id': 'id-2'},
        {'title': 'Different', 'source': 'github', 'source_id': 'id-3'},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 3

def test_not_mutated():
    """Test that input is not mutated"""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Python', 'source': 'github', 'source_id': 'py-1'},
    ]
    original = copy.deepcopy(rows)
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert rows == original

def test_preserves_order():
    """Test that order is preserved for first occurrences"""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 's1', 'source_id': 'id-1'},
        {'title': 'B', 'source': 's2', 'source_id': 'id-2'},
        {'title': 'C', 'source': 's3', 'source_id': 'id-3'},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert [r['title'] for r in result] == ['A', 'B', 'C']

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_stable_dedup_basic()
    test_source_id_none()
    test_no_source()
    test_dedup_across_same_source()
    test_not_mutated()
    test_preserves_order()
    print('All tests passed')
